name: argos-tools
description: Focused Argos workflow skills for Codex: review, critique, planning, council and research.

interface.shortDescription: Run focused external advisory workflows from one plugin: review, critique, planning, council, and research.
interface.longDescription: Argos Tools exposes the local Argos CLI through Codex skills for implementation review, adversarial critique, configurable planning depth, persistent councils, and decision-support research. The plugin is a lightweight facade: Argos executes local workflows and writes auditable artifacts, but never launches Codex.
defaultPrompt: Run $argos when you want the model to choose the lightest adequate Argos workflow.
Run $argos-review for implementation/testability checks before coding.
Run $argos-critique after a concrete proposal to identify blockers and improvements.
Run $argos-plan with light/medium/high depth when you need planning guidance.
Run $argos-council for persistent one- or two-partner deliberation on hard decisions.
Run $argos-research for source-backed, decision-oriented research before committing to a technical direction.
